content.description: Illustration showing removal of pinion adjusting screw lock nut using SST tool

content.text: 11. REMOVE PINION ADJUSTING SCREW LOCK NUT
Using SST, remove the pinion adjusting lock nut.
12. REMOVE PINION ADJUSTING SCREW
Using SST, remove the pinion adjusting screw.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of rack ends and claw washer using SST tools

content.text: 13. REMOVE RACK ENDS AND CLAW WASHER
(a) Unstake the claw washer.
Avoid any impact to the rack.
(b) Using SST, remove the rack ends.
Mark the left and right rack ends.
(c) Remove the claw washer.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of cylinder end stopper nut using SST

content.text: 14. REMOVE CYLINDER END STOPPER NUT
(a) Unstake the staked part of cylinder housing.
(b) Using SST, remove the cylinder end stopper nut.
15. REMOVE RACK HOUSING
(a) Remove the four bolts.
(b) Remove the rack housing.
(c) Remove the O-ring.

content.description: Illustration showing spacer removal from rack housing with 20 mm (0.79 in.) measurement indicated

content.text: 16. REMOVE SPACER FROM RACK HOUSING
17. REMOVE STEERING RACK WITH CYLINDER END STOPPER, O-RING, RACK END GUIDE AND WAVE WASHER FROM CYLINDER HOUSING
(a) Insert SST into the cylinder housing until oil seal lip.

content.description: Detailed illustration showing O-ring, Wave Washer, Rack End Guide, Stopper components with SST tool

content.text: (b) Remove the steering rack with the stopper, O-ring wave washer and rack end guide.
(c) Remove each part from the rack.
(d) Remove SST from rack housing.
